svg.title: RTCP: three packets in one datagram
svg.desc: The RTCP datagram of frame 633 of wireshark_aaa.pcap, 32 bits per row, three packets one after the other, each opened by a four-byte header: version 2 with a count, a packet type and a length in 32-bit words minus one. The Sender Report, type 200, length 6 for 28 bytes, carries the sender SSRC 0x3796cb71, a 64-bit NTP timestamp, the RTP timestamp 9411, 9 packets and 1548 octets sent. The Source Description, type 202, length 11 for 48 bytes, and the Goodbye, type 203, length 6 for 28 bytes, follow; RtcpCompound gives the three packets in wire order, their bodies as bytes, and the sender information of the report on demand.
